title: Meet Tanishka Aglave, 17, who built citrus disease tool and won $50,000
content: citrus greening has destroyed groves across the state, making what used to be a hallmark of Florida agriculture a hard fight for farmers . aglave was 17 when she set out to attack that fight on multiple fronts at once . she has come up with a three-pronged approach, which includes a treatment using curry leaves, a localized system for steam therapy and an artificial intelligence tool to help growers track the disease .

title: Meta agrees to report child-safety matters directly to Indian authorities
